summary: Phase A security correction VERIFIED — all 5 scenarios PASS. (1) API: a client X-Premium: 1 header CANNOT lift a free user above the free quota — with free_spark_limit=0, (a) POST /api/sparks/generate as a brand-new signed-up user with 'Authorization: Bearer <user>' + 'X-Premium: 1' → HTTP 402 'You've used this month's free Sparks.' (identical body without the header → 402); (c) same endpoint as admin (server-verified premium) with limits.premium_daily_cap=0 → HTTP 429 'You've reached the Spark limit for today. It resets automatically.' — proving the header is ignored and only the admin role unlocks the Premium lane. (2) UI non-premium 402: signed-up a fresh user via /auth?mode=signup (auth-name-input/auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button) → ran the Couple create flow (who-option-partner → vibe-option-romantic → budget-option-50-100 → distance-option-10 + 'Austin, TX' via location-input/location-search-button → find-sparks-button → when-find-sparks-button) → app auto-navigated to /premium?reason=limit; browser-back landed on /create/results showing results-limit=TRUE and results-premium-button=TRUE. (2 cont.) UI admin success: logged in as admin via UI (admin = isPremium in the app), same create flow — spark-card-0 rendered in ~36s with no error. Needed a one-off premium_daily_cap bump because the shared admin identity's 15/day was exhausted from prior iterations today (same shared-infra note as iteration_10 — restored to 15 at the end). (3) UI Premium ceiling honest message: with premium_daily_cap=0 and free=3, admin create flow → results-rate-limited rendered with headline 'Taking a short breather' and helper text 'This is a temporary usage limit, not a problem with your Premium plan — your access is unchanged.' (contains 'not a problem with your Premium plan' ✓). (4) /admin shows the limits-section label: 'Generation limits (server-enforced; X-Premium claims are ignored — the Premium lane applies only to server-verified accounts)' — the exact 'X-Premium claims are ignored' phrase is present (admin.tsx:180). (5) Regression: GET /api/config/public → features {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true, venue_hours:true, real_routing:false} ✓; /spark/b50acd38-5411-4b6f-ae1f-25fb40f7d711 with localStorage.guest_id='guest-hours-demo-02' renders spark-itinerary + itinerary-step-{0..2}-hours + hours-summary + cost-summary + cost-total ✓; tabs (tab-home, tab-sparks, tab-create, tab-profile) render on tab-layout screens (tab-create click succeeded in-flow). FINAL config restored and verified: free_spark_limit=3, limits={ip_hourly_cap:20, ip_daily_cap:80, guest_ids_per_ip_daily:20, premium_daily_cap:15, premium_monthly_cap:60}. Total LLM generations consumed this run: 1 (admin success case).
